title: Introduce slice-seed profiling and compact release annotator
author: Maya Patel
description:
Context: onboarding and release notes for model profiles often miss distributional edge cases (long tail of token lengths, bursty token patterns) and manually-written changelogs are noisy. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) a slice-seed generator that constructs small, reproducible synthetic workload slices to seed profiling runs during onboarding and regression checks; and (2) a compact release annotator that synthesizes concise changelog bullets focused on performance deltas and metadata changes for model profiles.

Design summary: the slice-seed generator takes a compact profile descriptor (percentile token-length histogram, sample-rate, and request signature templates) and emits a deterministic set of requests that exercise headroom, KV-cache growth patterns, and streaming hotspots. Seeds are small (default 256 requests) and are parametrized by "slice keys" (e.g. latency-sensitive, long-context, high-embed-rate). The profile schema is bumped to v2 to include slice_metadata and seed_fingerprint. The compact release annotator consumes profile diffs (old vs new) and emits a 1-3 line release blurb with: impacted models/variants, delta in 50/95/99 latency and median token-cost, changed quantization flags, and a reliability flag if any regression exceeds thresholds. The annotator also attaches a machine-readable annotation for downstream UI/console ingestion.

Checklist performed: 
- [x] design RFC linked and reviewed (ENG-1789)
- [x] schema v2 introduced with backwards-compatible getters
- [x] deterministic seed generator + unit tests
- [x] CI hook that runs slice seeds against profile candidate artifacts
- [x] compact annotator with release blurb + JSON annotation output
- [x] docs update for onboarding and release notes usage

How it works (developer notes): 
- profiles/schema_v2.yaml: new fields slice_metadata (list of slice descriptors) and seed_fingerprint (sha256 of canonicalized seed payload).
- profiles/slice_generator.py: CLI and library API to render N requests from a slice descriptor; supports templated prompts and stochastic sampling seeds for reproducibility.
- changelog/compact_emitter.py: comparator that computes delta summary and formats both human and machine outputs. Emits annotations to release bundle under annotations/compact.json.
- CI: scripts/ci_profile_check.sh invokes the generator and runs lightweight perf harness against the candidate profile bundle. The CI step is gated and can be skipped with [ci skip-profile-check] for fast iteration.

Testing and validation: added tests/test_slice_generator.py (determinism, fingerprint stability) and tests/test_compact_emitter.py (edge-case diffs, thresholding). Local perf runs on a small GPU instance confirm that the seeded slices reproduce a mean 2.1% token-cost variance across runs (within acceptable noise).

Rollout plan: land to main behind feature flag profile.slice_seed.enabled default=false. After a brief dogfood period (1 week) enable for automatic onboarding runs and allow teams to opt-in for release annotation. Console will display compact blurb and a link to the full diff.

Migration notes: existing profiles without slice_metadata are supported; schema helpers will synthesize a default slice (percentiles from historical telemetry) if none present. There is no breaking change to existing API surface.

Related: Linear ENG-1789 (design), PM-412 (release flow). Internal RFC: https://rfd.internal.redwood/eng/1789-slice-seed (internal only).

release_notes:
- Introduce profile schema v2 with slice_metadata and deterministic seed fingerprints.
- Add slice-seed generator to create compact reproducible workload seeds for onboarding and regression tests.
- Add compact release annotator to synthesize concise performance changelogs and attach machine-readable annotations to releases.
